# jcode v1.0.6

**Privacy-first telemetry and reasoning-safe output.** Usage telemetry is now opt-in and ships disabled by default — regulated and government deployments send nothing until you explicitly enable it. DeepSeek-style inline reasoning markers are split out of visible text, so Bailian/DashScope-served models show thinking in the reasoning area and auth-test stops misreporting valid credentials.

Download: <https://github.com/kolehank/jcode/releases/tag/v1.0.6>
